scope.summary: Author the canonical named-color primitive StudioSwatch (schema id hsk.studio.swatch@1): declares a swatch_kind, a StudioColorProfile-tagged value, and membership in an optional swatch group. Swatch kinds: process (ordinary process color), global (process color that live-updates every object using it when edited), spot (named separation ink, first-class native primitive, optional Lab definition for accurate screen/proof simulation independent of CMYK, tintable), mixed_ink (one spot + process inks in one swatch), mixed_ink_group (stepped series generated from base inks with editable steps), tint (percentage tint of a base swatch that follows base edits), plus reserved built-ins (None, Paper/Background, Registration, Black). Reference canonical StudioSwatch from MT-002; never fork.
acceptance_criteria: StudioSwatch@1 with all 6 kinds + reserved built-ins; profile-tagged; swatch panel; no fork
expected_tests: test: StudioSwatch@1 with swatch_kind {process,global,spot,mixed_ink,mixed_ink_group,tint,reserved} round-trips; StudioColorProfile-tagged value
argus: swatch panel renders kinds with stable author_ids

risk_if_missed: No named-color primitive; swatches forked; color reuse unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
